name: Boards
description: Task lists and Kanban boards in notes. ```tasks folder=Projects``` lists open todos from across your notes, live, to check off where they are; ```kanban``` draws its own markdown (## columns, - cards) as a board, and dragging a card rewrites the block. It runs sandboxed.

files:read.why: List the todos in your notes, and read a board's note

files:write.why: Check off a todo in its note, and move a board's cards in its note

embeds.title: Task list
embeds.description: Todos (- [ ] lines) from across your notes, gathered live and sorted by due date. Check one off here and it's checked off in its note; its note's name opens it.

folder.description: Only notes in this folder, like Projects

due.description: Only those due: overdue, today, week (the next 7 days), or any (with a date)

embeds.title: Kanban board
embeds.description: A board drawn from the block's markdown: each ## heading a column, each - line under it a card. Drag a card to another column or place, and the block's markdown is rewritten to match.
embeds.body: ## Column, then - card lines under it, for each column
